items.q: we didn't have any money, we were fishing for flounder and taking -- Neal Reed was baking apple pies and we were eating flounder and applie pies just for days

ctx.x: No, the guy started not paying us off after July 4th, I don't know he was -- and we didn't have any money, we were fishing for flounder and taking -- Neal Reed was baking apple pies and we were eating flounder and applie pies just for days. The guys were -- so, we finally got them started coming back to town.
